name: Righteous Heritor
description:
Prerequisite: level 4+

You can channel cosmic forces of good to gain these benefits: Soothe Pain. When you or a creature within 30 feet of you takes damage, you can use your reaction to reduce that damage by 1d10 + your proficiency bonus. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

feat: scion of the outer planes|sato|scion of the outer planes (good outer plane)
